messages.subject: Chromosome​Explorer problem-- take long time loading and haven't seen the result loaded so far.
parts:
Dear all,
I have followed the vignette and sample code to process CNV for SNP6.0
chips. I have finished CBS segmentation and now am ready to visualize
the result using ChromosomeExplorer.
I didn't get any error message so far. After the following step I got
report folder C:\......\reports\1sample test\ACC,ra,-XY,BPN,-XY,AVG,A
+B,FLN,-XY,paired
and a HTML file "ChromosomeExplorer.html". I thought this would be the
result I should open with firefox (version 3.6.23 is what I have).
After I open the link it just kept loading for long time and no figure
showed so far. Please let me know what I did wrong.
Thanks,
Qian

#visualize segmentation results for 20 test samples
ce_test <- ChromosomeExplorer(sm_test)
# Arrays to be modelled
setArrays(ce_test,"array 1")
# Use a different data set name for the output
setAlias(ce_test, "1sample test")
print(ce_test)
#process(ce_test, verbose=verbose)
#To do only a subset of the chromosomes, say chromosome 19, 22, and 23
(X), do:
process(ce_test, chromosomes=c(19,22,23), verbose=verbose)

On Tue, Nov 8, 2011 at 12:20 PM, Qian <little...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Dear Henrik,
> Thanks for your reply. I do find some error message in the
> process(ce_test, chromosomes=c(19,22,23), verbose=verbose)

That call should not generate the below error, which complains about
chromosome 25. To avoid the latter, you may want to do:

process(ce_test, chromosomes=1:24, verbose=verbose)

instead of

process(ce_test, verbose=verbose)

> I looked for the PNG files in the reports folder and there is only a
> xls file regions.xls, no PNG files were generated.
Look under reports/<dataSet>/<tags>/<chipType>/cbs/*.png

> what should I do to fix the error? I already downloaded and intalled
> the older version of firefox.

You also need to update your R and aroma.affymetrix et al. You run
really old versions, meaning your on your own troubleshooting anything
that looks like bugs.

/Henrik
